categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes P2P private broadcast connection handling in src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp, and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents adversaries from correlating transactions by exploiting a timing side channel in private broadcast. When a transaction was received back or invalidated early, remaining initial connection attempts were canceled, creating a side channel that leaked broadcast origin; ensuring all initial connections complete fixes this privacy leak.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Test changes only cover the private broadcast feature itself, and the touch to test_runner.py is a mechanical addition of the new functional test.
categories.rationale: Not test infrastructure work; testing changes are domain tests accompanying the P2P private broadcast logic.
